Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players of Sri Lanka Women are out in the middle. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers for India. Achini Kulasuriya to start with the ball.
...THE RUN CHASE...

Right then! Not a big score to chase and India Women will hope to seal the series here only. We saw in the first ODI that Sri Lanka Women bowlers made it hard for India to chase an under-par total and a similar performance will be expected by Chamari Atapattu. Stay tuned as we will be back with the chase in a bit.

India Women bowlers have yet again shown their class as they have notched up another excellent performance. They will be slightly disappointed as well because there were a couple of run out chances and stumping chances that went here and there that could have made a difference to the scoreboard. Renuka Singh was the start of the show as she dictated terms from the start and with discipline bowling, she ended with four wickets and was economical as well. The spinners controlled the middle phase and kept it tight throughout as well. This all-round performance has helped India end the first phase on the front foot.

Sri Lanka Women will be pretty disappointed with the score. A good start was required and the openers failed miserably. They were three down inside 10 overs and needed someone to repair things. Chamari Atapattu and Anushka Sanjeewani joined hands but after getting to a start, both fell. Nilakshi de Silva too failed after building a good partnership and that seemed to be a problem for them. The batters got a start but failed to stay out there and chip in runs. It was Ama Kanchana's crucial innings at the backend that helped Sri Lanka get past the 150-score.
So, Sri Lanka Women have not learned their lessons as they have ended up with a similar score as the first ODI and yet again they will look up to the bowlers to make it a competitive game.

OUT! CAUGHT! India Women have bundled out Sri Lanka Women yet again this time. It is tossed up, full and on off. Achini Kulasuriya swings hard at it but only lofts it towards cover. Harleen Deol takes a dolly. SRI LANKA WOMEN END THEIR INNINGS AT 173/10.
Commentary.Howout: c Harleen Deol b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Achini Kulasuriya walks out.

OUT! STUMPED! Deepti Sharma gets herself into the wicket's colum. It is tossed up, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera comes down the track but is unable to work it away. Yastika Bhatia collects the ball and clips the bails in no time.
Commentary.Howout: st Yastika Bhatia b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: A single now as this is worked down to long off.
A low full toss, on off. Inoka Ranaweera is only able to help it down to long on for a single.
This time it is much fuller, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera swings hard at it but misses.
Tossed up, around leg. Ama Kanchana hits it down to long on for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera looks to cut it away but misses.
Short ball, on off, Ama Kanchana pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Poor throw this time. It is full, on the pads. Inoka Ranaweera flicks it to mid-wicket for a risky single. The throw is a poor one and the batter makes it safely at the non-striker's end.
Length ball, on off. Inoka Ranaweera punches it to cover.
DROPPED! A tough chance though. It is full length, on off. Ama Kanchana lofts it towards mid off. The fielder puts in a late dive forward and fails to grab it. They sneak a single.
Full length, wide outside off. Ama Kanchana reaches out and lofts it over backward point. Two fielders give it a chase. They work in tandem to keep it down to two.
On off, defended out.
Fuller and on off. Inoka Ranaweera looks to flick it away but it goes to the off side off the leading edge.
WIDE! Flighted and full, wide outside off. Inoka Ranaweera leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide.
Quicker, full and on off. Inoka Ranaweera pushes it to mid on.
Looped up, angled down leg, Inoka Ranaweera tucks it to square leg.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and outside off. Ama Kanchana lofts it over covers for a fine boundary. This is just her second boundary of the innings.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Ama Kanchana flicks it through square leg for a single.
Full length, on off. Inoka Ranaweera gets inside the line and flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Full length, outside off, defended out watchfully.
Length ball, on the pads, Inoka Ranaweera clips it to the leg side.

An appeal for run out! It is a length ball, outside off. Inoka Ranaweera pushes it to short cover. Ama Kanchana ventures out looking for a single, but is sent back. Sharma scores a direct hit but looks like Inoka Ranaweera makes it in time. The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm and the replays show that the batter is safe.
Full length, on off. Inoka Ranaweera lifts it over covers for two runs.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
Around off, blocked out.
Darted on the pads, Inoka Ranaweera flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. She gets off the mark.
Full and on off, pushed to mid on.
Tossed up, on off. Inoka Ranaweera flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
Floated and full, outside off. Ama Kanchana dabs it to backward point for one.
Length ball, outside off. Kanchana punches it to covers for a single.
Renuka now serves it full and outside off, played back to the bowler.
Length and outside off. Kanchana swings and misses.
Full and on off. Kanchana lofts it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs. She plays a key role now to help Sri Lanka cross at least 180-mark.
Inoka Ranaweera is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Renuka Singh gets her fourth wicket! She has been brilliant with the ball! This is full and around off. Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to go over covers but mistimes her shot and it goes off the cue end, high and to covers where Deepti Sharma runs back and takes a pretty comfortable catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on off. Oshadi Ranasinghe punches it to covers.
Another single as this full ball is driven to sweeper cover.
Quicker, full and on middle, whipped to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Oshadi Ranasinghe swings across and hits it to long on for a single.
Around off, dabbed to backward point.
Full again on off, pushed to covers. Oshadi Ranasinghe wants a single but is sent back.
Tossed up on middle. Defended out.
Outside off, Oshadi Ranasinghe hits it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller ball, on off. Kanchana turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Kanchana steps across and blocks it.
On off, Oshadi Ranasinghe works it to deep point for a single.

A direct hit and Kanchana was a goner! Fuller and angling on the pads. Kanchana misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls to covers and there is a mix-up as the batters look for a quick single. Kanchana gave up and there was a chance but the fielder misses her shy at the bowler's end. Deepti Sharma was standing there near the stumps and could have collected it to dislodge the bails.
Angling on the pads. Kanchana tickles it straight to short fine leg.
On the pads, Oshadi Ranasinghe bunts it straight to square leg.
On middle, kept out.
Slower and outside off. Oshadi Ranasinghe waits and dabs it to backward point.
Flatter and outside off. Kanchana stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated again. Oshadi Ranasinghe drops it to point and takes a quick single.
Floated, full and on middle. Blocked out solidly.
Full ball on middle. Oshadi Ranasinghe works it to point for another single. Another stand building here for Sri Lanka.
A slower bouncer, outside off. Oshadi Ranasinghe tries hard to pull it but misses.
Length ball, on the pads, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on middle. Kanchana wrists it past mid-wicket and collects a couple of runs.
Touch fuller and outside off. Kanchana pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
Wide! A length ball, way outside off. Kanchana tries to slash at it but misses. Wide given.
Full and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
Around off, pushed to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Kanchana comes down the track and tries to heave but mistimes it a bit. The ball lobs past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs.
A low full toss, flighted on off, driven straight to mid off.
Flatter and on off. Blocked on the front foot.
On a length and outside off, turning away. Oshadi Ranasinghe looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge past short third man for three runs.
A single as this is pulled to deep square leg.
A single as this is pushed to sweeper cover.
Length ball, on the stumps. Ama Kanchana stays back and blocks it out.
FOUR! Ama Kanchana is keeping her cool here. It is full, on leg. Ama Kanchana flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Oshadi Ranasinghe pulls it through square leg for a single.
A short ball, on off. It gets big on the batter. Oshadi Ranasinghe is on her toes to defend it out.
Oshadi Ranasinghe comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Meghna Singh comes back into the attack and strikes instantly. It is fuller and on off. Nilakshi de Silva stays back and closes the face of the blade a little early. The ball takes the leading edge and lobs towards covers. Deepti Sharma takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Meghna Singh (7-0-27-1) is back on.
Tossed up, around off. Ama Kanchana stays back and smothers it out.
Short ball, wide of off. Nilakshi de Silva cuts it to deep point for a single.
Fuller, on off, blocked out.
Touch short, outside off. Ama Kanchana pushes it to point for one.
Full, outside off. Ama Kanchana blocks it out to backward point.
On middle and leg, defended out.
Ama Kanchana flicks this full delivery to mid-wicket for one.

FOUR WIDES! It is looped up, angled down leg. Nilakshi de Silva fails to pick it up and so does the keeper. The ball rolls down to fine leg and the batters take three runs. Also, the umpire deems it as wide.
On the pads, Ama Kanchana flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Close, but safe! Could've been another run out here.Full and on off. Ama Kanchana pushes it to mid on. The non-striker is down the track but gets back just in time.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Not a tough chance to be honest, Fuller, on off. Nilakshi de Silva slams it back to the bowler, it comes on really slowly. Deepti Sharma puts her one arm in the air but is unable to gather it. Nilakshi de Silva gets a lifeline here.
It is fuller, on off. Nilakshi de Silva gets down on one knee and sweeps it to square leg.
A tidy over by Harmanpreet Kaur comes to an end. It is flatter and on off. Ama Kanchana blocks it out solidly.
Length ball, on off. Ama Kanchana taps it back to the bowler.
Another one on the pads, Nilakshi de Silva tucks it to the leg side for one more.
Floated and full, on middle. Ama Kanchana comes across and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Darted on the pads, Nilakshi de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Touch short, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it to covers.
Slower in the air, flatter and outside off. De Silva punches it to covers. The stand between these two is 30 runs now. Just what Sri Lanka Women wanted.
Slightly full and outside off. De Silva pushes it through point for a single.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Two byes! This one lands on off and spins away. De Silva is squared up as she looks to defend but misses. The keeper fumbles and the batters take two as it rolls to third man.
Quicker this time, fuller and on off. De Silva defends with a straight bat.
Flighted, slower and around off. De Silva plays it to covers.
A single as this full ball is pushed to backward point for a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
Shorter and on middle. De Silva pulls it hard but straight to the fielder at square leg.
Floats it full and outside off, eased on the off side for a single.
Flatter ball, around off. De Silva prods and blocks it out.
A juicy full toss on middle, De Silva flicks it straight to mid-wicket. She will feel, she missed out there.
TAP AND RUN! Tossed up, outside off. De Silva drops it in front of point and takes a quick single. Good running there.
On off, fuller, blocked out.
A flighted ball, outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.

Halt in play! Nilakshi de Silva gets hit on her helmet. The physio is out to have a look at her. Nilakshi de Silva goes through a concussion test. She is fine to continue, as the physio walks off the field alone.

Slides a full ball, down around leg, it spins back into the batter. De Silva looks to sweep but misses and the ball bounces more and hits her on the helmet. She looks fine but a concussion protocol will follow.
Fuller and outside off. De Silva steps down and across to defend it.
Flatter, outside off, turning in. De Silva punches it to covers.
On middle, fuller, blocked out.
Shorter, outside off, stays a bit low. De Silva cuts it to deep point for a run.
Tossed up on middle. De Silva hangs back and turns it to mid on.
Full and wide of off. Kanchana drives it to point for a single.
A loopy ball, on off. Kanchana blocks it out.
Around off, pushed through point for a single.

Chance! Flatter, and just outside off. Kanchana dances down the track and looks to defend but the ball spins away and Yastika Bhatia behind has a chance to whip the bails off but fails to collect it cleanly. She had more time than she thought.
This one drifts back in sharply, length and on middle. Kanchana tucks it to square leg.
Floated, full and on off. Kanchana comes down the track and defends it out.
On off, kept out.
Tossed up on middle. Kanchana skips down and blocks it.
Wide! This is short and down the leg side. Kanchana gets on her knee to sweep but misses. An appeal for caught behind but nothing given.
Flatter and spinning in, outside off, punched to covers.
This one turns in a touch. Nilakshi de Silva stays back and pushes it to covers.
Looped up, around off, defended out solidly.
Fuller, on the pads, Ama Kanchana clips it to the leg side for one. 100 up for the hosts.
Slightly shorter, outside off. Ama Kanchana slaps it to cover-point for one.
On the pads, Nilakshi de Silva flicks it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Flighted, full and outside off. Nilakshi de Silva lifts it over covers and finds the boundary.
It is tossed up, outside off. Ama Kanchana tries to defend it out but misses.
An arm ball this time, that shapes in. Ama Kanchana tries to play it late but only to get a nick on it. Yastika Bhatia it unable to gather it cleanly.
Ama Kanchana stays back to defend this full delivery.
Floated, around off, blocked to mid off.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
Looped up, full and on off. Ama Kanchana defends it to mid off.

Drinks! Things not looking good for Sri Lanka Women as they are losing wickets at quick intervals. Nilakshi de Silva plays a key role from here as she can help her team reach a competitive total while India will hope to take the remaining wickets quickly and keep Sri Lanka under 150.
Fuller, on middle, Ama Kanchana flicks it to square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off, pushed to mid off.
Slower again, full and on off. Kanchana blocks it back.
Slower one this time, on the pads, Nilakshi de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on the pads, Ama Kanchana flicks it to square leg for one.
Swing and a miss! Back of a length, wide outside off. Ama Kanchana looks to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Floated and full, on off. Nilakshi de Silva defends it to the left of the bowler.
Full and on the pads, Ama Kanchana flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
On off, defended back to the bowler.
Fuller, on off. Ama Kanchana hits it to the right of mid on but the fielder does well to make a solid stop.
A single now as this is worked to long on.
Looped up, fuller and on leg. Nilakshi de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket.
TWO LEG BYES! A length ball, on the pads, Ama Kanchana is unable to clip it away. It goes to fine leg off the pads. They cross for two.
Length ball, on off. Ama Kanchana works it to mid on.
WIDE! Full length, down leg. Ama Kanchana fails to glance it away. Wide called.
Slower one, on a length, wide outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pushes it to point for one.
Touch fuller, on the pads, Ama Kanchana flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
On a length, outside off. Ama Kanchana blocks it with full face of the blade.
Full length, on off. Ama Kanchana blocks it out.
Shorter and on middle, Kanchana bunts it to deep square leg for one more.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to covers.
Shorter and sliding around middle and leg. Kanchana shuffles across and looks to block but gets an inside edge and the ball lobs just near her. Not near the keeper.
On middle. Kanchana blocks it out.
Ama Kanchana is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT!  A run out appeal! A single replay is enough to make a decision! Out it is! The last thing the Lankans wanted at this moment! Flatter and outside off. Dilhari punches it firmly to mid off and calls for a quick single but Nilakshi de Silva is ball watching and fails to answer the call. Dilhari has to run back from the halfway track and Yastika Bhatia collects the throw and whips the bails off.
Length ball, outside off. Kept out.
A bouncer on middle. Dilhari pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Lucky one! Short ball, outside off. Dilhari tries to use the pace as she tries to ramp it up but Deepti Sharma is standing near the short third man region and she leaps but fails to hold on. It rolls behind for a boundary.
Full, slower and outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Fuller and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Length, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva shuffles across and punches it to cover.
FOUR! A loosener to start with. It is full, angled down leg. Nilakshi de Silva flicks it to fine leg for four.
On off, defended out.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side. Dilhari misses her flick. Wided.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
On middle. Blocked out.
Who will walk out now? It will  be Kavisha Dilhari.

OUT! RUN OUT! A run out appeal! Yastika Bhatia, the keeper might have just given the breakthrough! Out it is! Oh, dear, what has Anushka Sanjeewani done here! Brilliant from Yastika Bhatia though! Anushka Sanjeewani played all over it! Flighted, full and on off. Sanjeewani first tries to play the reverse sweeps but it is too full and she adjusts late to block it out. She takes a step out of the crease and is not aware of where the ball is. It rolls on the leg side and Bhatia is quick to run across and under arms on the stumps, with her back towards the stumps. She puts up an appeal and it is taken upstairs. The replay shows Anushka Sanjeewani fails to drag her bat inside the crease and her foot was out as well. Loss of concentration there and Anushka Sanjeewani loses her wicket.
Too full and on off. Nilakshi de Silva steps across and drives it to long on for one.
Slower, fuller and on off. Nilakshi de Silva gets behind the line to block it.
Tad short and on middle. Nilakshi de Silva gets low and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Nilakshi de Silva blocks it on the deck.
On off, kept out.

Three runs! A floated ball, outside off. Sanjeewani tries to reverse sweep but edges it past the keeper and down the ground. The fielder from slip gives a chase and cuts it down near the fence. Three taken.
Tossed up on off. Sanjeewani skips down and eases it to mid on.
On middle, nudged past square leg for a single.
Length and on off, punched to covers.
FOUR! Well played! Bangs a bouncer, outside off. Sanjeewani hops and upper cuts it over short third man for a boundary.
Length ball, just outside off. Nilakshi de Silva shuffles across and tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter now on middle. Nilakshi de Silva sits under it.
A length ball, in a tight channel, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva looks to push but misses.
Full length, on off. Nilakshi de Silva defends it back to the bowler.
Floated and full, around off. Anushka Sanjeewani blocks it out. 5 runs off it.
Looped up, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva guides it to point for a single.
On middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Floated and full, on leg. Nilakshi de Silva blocks.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is full, angled down leg. Nilakshi de Silva gets low and sweeps it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller, on leg, worked to mid-wicket.
Fuller, wide of off. Nilakshi de Silva punches it through cover-point for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Nilakshi de Silva tries to pull it away but only manages to connect with thin air.
A slower bumper, on middle. de Silva ducks under it.
Full length, wide outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani lifts it over point and gets across for a run.
Length, outside off, defended out.
BEATEN! Full length, outside off, this one stays a touch low. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to defend it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fullish delivery, outside off. Nilakshi de Silva pats it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani punches it down to third man for a single.
Full length, on off. Anushka Sanjeewani drives to mid on but there is protection there.
Length ball, on off, pushed to covers.
Another short one, down the middle. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to slog it away but misses it completely.
FOUR! Fortunate this time. It is a short ball, around middle and leg. Anushka Sanjeewani gets a glove on it. It flies over the keeper and finds the boundary.
Full length, around middle and leg. Nilakshi de Silva walks across and flicks it to mid-wicket.

4 LEG BYES! OUCH! That must've hurt. It is a sharp bouncer, around middle. Nilakshi de Silva ducks under it but it hits her on the helmet and evades the keeper for four. The umpire signals it as leg byes. She goes through a mandatory concussion check. She is fine to continue.
On a length, wide outside off, Nilakshi de Silva looks to slash it away but misses.
Length, around off, defended out.
Full length, wide outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani punches it through covers for one.
It is full and on the stumps. Anushka Sanjeewani gets it to the off side off the outer half.
Fuller ball and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
Nilakshi de Silva walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! The 31-run stand is broken! A timely wicket for India and they are back in the driving seat! Chamari Atapattu could have left this though and collected a wide but she doesn't! Not the best of delivery as this is full and down the leg side. Chamari Atapattu gets a bit low and tries to whip it uppishly over fine leg but no power on the shot and holds out straight in the hands of Shafali Verma there. Easy catch for her.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Chamari Atapattu skips down and Meghna bowls a short one, around off. Atapattu looks to pull but misses. Good awareness there.
A length ball, outside off. Sanjeewani cuts it to deep point for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Wide! A short ball, on middle, rare one. Sanjeewani leaves it alone. A wide given for height.
Just four runs off the over then! Too many dot balls by the batters! Around middle, blocked out.
An off-breaker, full and on off. Blocked out.
FOUR! Good shot! A welcome boundary! A flighted ball, around off. Chamari Atapattu slog-sweeps it in the gap, to deep square leg for a boundary.
A loopy ball, full and on off, spinning away. Chamari Atapattu lunges to defend but misses.
On off, blocked out.
Flighted, full and around middle and off. Chamari Atapattu gets on her knee to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but not given.
Good pace this time! Length and outside off. Not much width again. Sanjeewani looks to push but misses.
Overpitched and outside off. Sanjeewani drives it straight and on the stumps on the other side. Was hit really well but no run for that.
Drops it short and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes it full and on off, hit to mid off.
On a length and outside off, slower. Chamari Atapattu stays rooted to her crease to push but misses.
Full and on off. Sanjeewani drives it straight for a single.

Drinks! It has been a solid start by the visitors. Three wickets inside 10 and they are well on top right now. Renuka Singh has whizzed past through the opening order with discipline bowling and she has got her reward. There is a small partnership building between Chamari Atapattu and Sanjeewani and Sri Lanka will hope it continues for a long time.
On the pads. Chamari Atapattu sweeps it to deep square leg. Again slow outfield and the batters get two runs.
Floats it up, full and outside off. Sanjeewani pushes it through covers for a single.
Tossed up on off. Sanjeewani prods and blocks it.
Very slower this, shorter and outside off. Sanjeewani cuts it late and hard through backward point. Kaur gives a chase and keeps it down to two.
Flighted, fuller and outside off, driven to covers for no run.
Full and on off. Blocked out.

Just short there! Shorter ball, on middle and turning onto the pads. Chamari Atapattu hangs back and tries to clip it but mistimes to mid-wicket where the ball drops in front of the fielder. India Women well in control here.
Tossed up, on middle, swept behind square on the leg side for a single.
This one drifts in with the angle, around off. Sanjeewani solidly blocks it.
Slightly short and outside off. Sanjeewani plays it to covers.
A loopy ball, outside off. Chamari Atapattu drives it on the up and to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter and way outside off. Chamari Atapattu looks to cut it hard but misses.
This time she finds the gap and takes a quick single. Floated on off. Chamari Atapattu gets on the front foot and drops it to cover-point for a quick single.
On off, Chamari Atapattu plays off the outer half and to point. Not in the gap.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Defended out.
Tossed up, around off, it lands and spins away. Chamari Atapattu lunges to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
This is full and outside off. Chamari Atapattu leaves it alone.
Tossed up on off. Chamari Atapattu prods and blocks it.
End of Powerplay 1! That means now four fielders can be placed outside the inner circle. Also, there is a change is bowling as Deepti Sharma comes into the attack.
On off, defended out. Rajeshwari Gayakwad starts with a maiden.
Full, on the pads, Anushka Sanjeewani flicks it to the leg side.
It is fuller, around middle and leg. Anushka Sanjeewani tries to defend it out but gets an inside edge on her pads.
It is looped up, around off. Anushka Sanjeewani goes for the sweep, although it takes the top-edge and falls in front of first slip.
Slower through the air, outside off. It turns away and Anushka Sanjeewani decides to stay away from chasing it.
Floated and full, around off. Anushka Sanjeewani gets on her front foot to block it out.
Good length, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani moves across and taps it to point for one.
It is full again, just outside off. Chamari Atapattu adjusts her hand and blocks it to covers for a quick single.
FOUR! Finally, Chamari Atapattu finds some success against Renuka Singh. Full length, outside off, slow in pace. Chamari Atapattu hangs back and lofts it over covers to find a boundary.
This one is on middle and fuller in length. Chamari Atapattu blocks it out to covers.
Full, around off, angling away from the left-hander. Chamari Atapattu stays back and defends it out.
Anushka Sanjeewani pushes this full delivery through covers from outside off. They cross for a single.
Length ball, at the stumps. Chamari Atapattu stays back and blocks it out.
Good length, around the hips. Anushka Sanjeewani clips it to mid-wicket. They take one.
Good length, wide outside off, shapes away a touch. Anushka Sanjeewani does not go chasing.
Fuller, on the pads, Chamari Atapattu flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
FOUR! Incredible shot! This is more like Chamari Atapattu. Full, wide outside off. Chamari Atapattu slaps it through the gap at covers and finds a rare boundary.
Fuller, outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani guides it down to third man for one.

Yet another wicket-taking over by Renuka Singh comes to an end. Chamari Atapattu continues to use her feet to take the lbw out of equation. It is full, outside off. Chamari Atapattu walks across but fails to block it out. It rolls out off her pads but no trouble.
Anushka Sanjeewani is off the mark! This is full, wide outside off. Anushka Sanjeewani taps it through point for one.
Singh continues to go full. Anushka Sanjeewani defends it out watchfully.
An inswinger this time, around off. Anushka Sanjeewani pushes it gently towards covers.
Touch fuller, on off. Anushka Sanjeewani defends it back to the bowler on the front foot.
Anushka Sanjeewani walks out to the middle.

OUT! LBW! Renuka Singh has been pretty relentless this morning. She picks her third wicket in no time. A length ball, around middle and leg. Harshitha Madavi is caught deep in her crease. She tries to defend it out but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Renuka Singh makes a huge appeal for lbw. The umpire thinks about and eventually raises his dreaded finger. Harshitha Madavi trudges back to the pavilion.
Fuller, aimed at the pads. Chamari Atapattu hangs back and clips it through square leg for two more. Chamari Atapattu is off to a cautious start here.
Good length, on off. Chamari Atapattu remains solid in her defense.
This is very full, angled down leg. Chamari Atapattu walks down the track and clips it straight to the fielder at square leg.
On off, defended out watchfully.
Length ball, around the pads. Chamari Atapattu tucks it to deep square leg and collects a brace. First real error from Singh.
Full length, around off, making the batter play at it. Chamari Atapattu stays back and blocks it out.
Another solid block from Madavi to end the over.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
Sri Lanka in a spot of bother already. They have lost two wickets inside the first 5 overs. Harshitha Madavi is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Vishmi Gunaratne was struggling to time the ball and she gives away her wicket. Another good ball from Renuka, she is bowling brilliantly in this opening phase. Just discipline bowling and not fancy work from the Indian bowlers. A full ball, outside off and swings back in sharply. Gunaratne steps down and looks to heave across but gets an inside edge and the ball shatters the stumps. Not a debut to remember.
On middle, blocked out.
Fullish ball, outside off. Gunaratne takes a step down and tries to go over the bowler but is too early to her shot and ends up chipping it back to Renuka who collects it on a bounce.
Length and outside off, punched to covers.

A huge appeal but not given! This is really beautifully bowled! Singh bowls it on a length and around off, it jags away slightly. Atapattu tries to push with soft hands but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Very full and around middle and off. Atapattu skips down and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Singh tries a yorker on middle. Gunaratne takes it on a full and pushes it to mid on. She calls for a quick single and makes her ground on time.
On a length and around off. Gunaratne steps across and bunts it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, just outside off, it nips away. Gunaratne looks to push but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, outside off. Atapattu dabs it to third man for a single.
Touch slower, fuller and on middle. Gunaratne stays back and makes a solid block on the leg side.
Too full and on middle. Gunaratne tucks it to mid-wicket.
This one swings in the air, fuller and around off. Gunaratne steps across and misses her flick.
An appeal for LBW but the impact was outside off. Full ball, outside off. Gunaratne shuffles across again to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Vishmi Gunaratne is off the mark now! Full ball, around off. Gunaratne shuffles across and flicks it past square leg for a brace.
Overpitched and on middle, drilled to mid on.
Full and on off. Kept out.

NOT OUT! Meghna hurls a full ball, angling across, outside off. Atapattu looks to drive against the angle but seems to get an outside edge to first slip where Deepti Sharma dives to her left and takes a stunner diving low. Now then, the Indian players appeal but the umpire just waits to check if it is a bump ball. The soft signal is not out. The TV umpire has numerous replays and different angles to make a decision. The replay shows the ball bounced before hitting the bat and then takes a huge deflection on its way to the fielder. But the decision is in Sri Lanka's favor means Atapattu survives. A very tough decision to make. no strong evidence to overturn.

Is that out? Although, the umpire isn't sure and takes it upstairs. He thinks the ball has touched the ground and the on-field decision is not out. After several replays the third umpire signals a green light, a tough decision as there was no clear evidence to overturn the decision,
This one swings into the pads. Atapattu tucks it to mid-wicket. Not much pace offered here.
Width given, fuller and outside off. Atapattu drives it firmly through covers and takes a couple of runs as the surface is not the quickest.
Around middle. Atapattu comes down the track and counters the swing as she makes a solid block.
A length ball, around middle and leg and it shapes into the left-hander. Atapattu blocks it out.
Meghna Singh to steam in from the other end.
Pitched up, around off. Gunaratne steps across and turns it to mid on.
Sri Lanka Women and Chamari Atapattu are underway! This is on the pads, it is flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Chamari Atapattu comes in at number 3. Also, three slips in place.

OUT! BOWLED! Hasini Perera goes without troubling the scorers! What a start for India! Singh sticks with the fuller ball and this time makes the ball to swing in from around off. Perera's foot goes nowhere as she tries to drive but the ball goes through the gate and rattles the stumps.
Singh sticks with the fuller-length, around off, it is pushed to mid off.
Full ball, around middle and leg. Perera nudges it to mid-wicket.
Singh starts with a full ball, around off. Perera drives it off the inner half of the bat and to mid-wicket.
We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. It will be Hasini Perera and Vishmi Gunaratne who walk out to open for Sri Lanka Women. Renuka Singh to start with the new ball.

Chamari Atapattu, the skipper of Sri Lanka Women says it looks like a good wicket to bat on. Adds they will stick to the plans and predicts 240 is a good score. Informs they have made a couple of changes and the skipper might open with Vishmi Gunaratne. Shares they lost wickets at the start in the first match and the set batters did not continue but hopes to do better in this game.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says they will bowl first. Mentions, there is a little moisture on the wicket. Adds they are playing three pacers and would look forward to make the most of the new ball. Further adds, the deck is much better this time around and informs they are sticking to the same side.

PITCH REPORT - Gamini Perera is near the deck. He informs us the outfield is slightly on the heavier side. The pitch is fresh along with some grass on it. It is quite hard, also there are some dark spots as it was under covers for the most of the time.

India Women (Unchanged playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Harleen Deol, Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh, Pooja Vastrakar, Renuka Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Meghna Singh.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Chamari Atapattu (C), Vishmi Gunaratne (In for Hansima Karunaratne), Hasini Perera, Harshitha Madavi, Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshi de Silva, Anushka Sanjeewani (WK), Oshadi Ranasinghe, Ama Kanchana (In for Rashmi de Silva), Inoka Ranaweera, Achini Kulasuriya.
TOSS - India Women have won the toss and they will BOWL first!

The hosts would be a tad disappointed with the batting effort in the previous game. They will be focusing on building partnerships in the middle and provide a solid foundation up top. This is their last chance to keep the series hopes alive. It is going to be an enticing battle. Stay tuned for toss and team updates.
